Avoid the first three days of Golden Week (early Oct) and the Spring Festival rush if you want quieter paths.
hotel: Base in Inner Mongolia: comfortable 3–4★ hotels typically ¥250–750/night within a taxi ride of the site; book early for weekends and holidays.
